QuestInfo.name: The Keepsake
QuestInfo.0: Neinheart has something important to say to you.
QuestInfo.1:
There was an accident while transporting Empress Aria's Keepsake. Retrieve #rEmpress Aria's Keepsake#k from the #rGhost Stumps#k at the #bGusty Peak#k.

Deliver the retrieved keepsake to #b10 Boogies#k in #bPerion#k.
QuestInfo.2: You successfully retrieved the Keepsake, which belonged the previous Empress, Aria. It's safe in 10 Boogies' hands now.

default.0: Please retrieve #rEmpress Aria's Keepsake#k from the #rGhost Stumps#k at the #bGusty Peak#k.
